prompts:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: master front-view A-pose character reference for modular image-to-3D modeling.
Input image 1 is the user's original character and the strict identity, outfit, color, and style reference.
Create ONE image of this exact character in a precise symmetrical front-facing A-pose. Full body including ear tips and slippers, centered upright, eye-level orthographic-looking camera with no perspective foreshortening, no head tilt. Both arms straight but relaxed extending diagonally down 35 degrees away from the torso (55 degrees below horizontal), hands visible and relaxed with individually readable fingers, legs straight and feet slightly separated and pointing forward. Leave clear white gaps between hands/arms and body.
Preserve the original cute anime character proportions and face identity, large pink-magenta eyes, small nose, light peach skin. A small relaxed closed-mouth smile suitable as neutral rigging base. Preserve peach-blonde long wavy hair with pink gradient ends, ahoge, two fluffy triangular cat ears, pink flower hairpin plus black X hairpin on viewer's right. No extra ears or accessories. Preserve cream oversized open hoodie with pink hood lining/trim/buttons and cat-face chest patch, pink T-shirt, cream pink-trim drawstring shorts, cream slouch socks with pink bands, pink-and-cream cat-face slippers. Preserve cream curved tail on viewer's right with pink bow and golden bell. Preserve the black choker and its separate small golden neck bell at front center; do not merge choker into skin or shirt.
Keep the hair flowing mostly behind the shoulders so arm and clothing silhouette is readable. Match garment coverage exactly; this is a fully clothed character modeling sheet.
Style: same polished delicate pastel anime illustration as reference, crisp readable outlines, gently shaded local colors, even neutral studio illumination, very little baked shadow. Pure solid white background, no ground shadow, no scenery, no text, labels, borders, measurements or watermark. Single figure, single front view, no grid or collage. High resolution portrait, comfortably framed with margins. Do not redesign costume or character.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: isolated fully clothed body component reference for image-to-3D.
Input image 1 is the approved master A-pose character. Extract and reconstruct ONLY the BODY component from this exact image.
Keep the precise A-pose, proportions, costume, pastel colors, shading, hands, legs, socks, cat slippers, and tail with its pink bow and golden bell. Keep cream oversized open hoodie with pink trim/lining/buttons and cat patch, pink T-shirt, cream pink-edged drawstring shorts unchanged. Match exact garment coverage and silhouette.
REMOVE the entire head, all hair, cat ears, hairpins, and the black neck choker including its small bell. Keep a short clean skin-colored neck connector ending at mid-neck, with a smooth flat closed top like a modular figurine component. This is a clean design asset, no injury detail. Reconstruct the shoulders, hood, upper shirt and chest areas previously hidden by hair. Neck color must match the visible body skin in the master. Do not add a head-shaped placeholder or mannequin stand. Do not remove the tail bell.
Composition: a single isolated headless clothed body front view, orthographic-looking, neck-to-slippers fully visible, relaxed straight diagonal arms separated from torso, hands and feet fully in frame; character body fills most of portrait canvas with modest margins. Solid pure white background, no shadows cast on ground, no text, labels, collage, borders or watermark. Keep original clean pastel anime rendering and even illumination. Only one component image.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: isolated bald head and short neck connector reference for image-to-3D.
Input image 1 is the approved master A-pose and the exact facial identity reference.
Extract ONLY the head, including a full smooth hairless scalp and a short neck connector. Preserve the EXACT recognizable face from reference: very large pink-magenta anime eyes, matching eye contour, eyebrows, tiny nose, soft cheek blush, small relaxed closed-mouth smile, youthful rounded anime facial proportions, light peach skin. Front facing perfectly upright without tilt, bilateral eyes level. Reconstruct the forehead and scalp that were hidden beneath bangs; retain natural cranium volume rather than flattening the scalp.
Remove ALL hair including eyebrows? NO: preserve eyebrows and eyelashes; remove scalp hair, bangs, side locks, ahoge, cat ears, hairpins, black choker and its gold bell, clothing, shoulders, torso. There should be no additional human ears sticking out; smooth head sides because cat ears belong to the separate hair assembly.
Neck should extend slightly below the choker position in master for overlapping assembly and finish at a smooth clean flat base, like a modular figurine sculpt, without graphic injury detail.
One isolated centered head with short neck, no shoulders. Front orthographic-looking view, generously sized within square canvas with clean margin. Same pastel anime illustration, crisp outlines, subtly shaded skin, neutral even light, no dramatic shadows. Pure solid white background, no text, no labels, no multiple views or collage, no accessories. Keep facial expression and identity invariant; do not turn it into a generic realistic human head.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image is the isolated bald head reference to edit. Make ONE targeted correction: remove BOTH HUMAN EARS completely, including every ear rim and ear interior. Replace those two protrusions with smooth continuous side contours transitioning from temples into cheeks and jaw, keeping the head symmetrical. This character has cat ears on a separate hair component, so this head component must have ZERO ears. Preserve ALL other pixels/design as closely as possible: same exact pink eyes, eyebrows, eyelashes, small mouth, blush, skull height, chin, skin tones, neck connector, front-facing orientation and illustration style. Keep the entire head and neck visible with margins. Single head only, no hair, no shoulders, no collar, no cat ears. Clean genuine transparent background and clean antialiased edges with no stray pixels or halo. No text or extra views.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: standalone hair plus cat-ear assembly reference for image-to-3D.
Input image 1 is the approved master character. Create ONE isolated hair assembly faithfully extracted from it, keeping exact hairstyle design, proportions, flowing silhouette and colors.
Include the entire peach-blonde long layered wavy hair, center-swept bangs, side locks, large curled ahoge, gradual pink tips, both triangular cream cat ears with pink interiors and white inner fur, and the pink flower and black X hairpins on viewer's right. Cat ears and hairpins belong to this component. Preserve the same ear height and angles and asymmetric individual waves visible in the master.
REMOVE the face, eyeballs, eyebrows, all skin/scalp/neck, body, clothes, tail and black choker/bell. This is a hollow wearable hair shell displayed in place as if on the invisible original head. Leave a clean WHITE OPEN FACE APERTURE beneath the bangs, bounded by the side locks; do not paint a peach bald face, mannequin head, eyes or facial features into the opening. Preserve the hair crown and the outer hair volume, with long lengths extending down to the original mid-torso level. Fill only missing hair surfaces where removal requires it, without changing hairstyle.
Single centered straight-on front view, orthographic-looking; isolated complete assembly comfortably fits portrait canvas. Same delicate pastel anime illustration, fine readable outlines, very gentle form shading, even neutral lighting. Pure white background, no text, labels, diagrams, checkerboard, stand, shadows on floor, collage or watermark. Only the one hair/cat-ear/hairpin assembly.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image is the standalone hair, cat ears and hairpins to clean up.
Preserve this EXACT complete peach-blonde/pink hairstyle, both cat ears, ahoge, flower and black X hairpins. Make two technical corrections only:
1. Completely erase ALL white/yellow/skin-colored flecks and ghost fragments floating in the empty face/neck/torso opening and between the hair locks. In particular, the central yellow bell-like specks and white necklace-shaped ghost MUST disappear. The empty central cavity must contain absolutely nothing: no face, neck, body, collar, necklace, bell, white patch or residual silhouette. The hair, cat ears and the two hairpins are the only surviving objects.
2. Fit the COMPLETE hair silhouette inside the frame with at least 7 percent clear margins on all four sides. No strand tips should touch or cross the canvas edge.
Keep exact original hairstyle geometry, locks, colors and pastel anime rendering from this input, without redesigning or shortening it. Make a genuinely transparent background and empty transparent face opening, with clean antialiased object boundaries, no stray isolated pixels or halos. Single frontal hair assembly only, no text or extra views.

Edit the provided isolated hairstyle reference into a SQUARE 1536 by 1536 image with substantially MORE EMPTY SPACE around the complete hairstyle. This is a framing/outpainting correction, not a redesign.
The entire hair assembly must occupy only the central 70 percent of the image width and 80 percent of the image height. Leave at least 10 percent of the full canvas dimension completely empty on EVERY side. Every outer strand tip, including the big outward curls on the far lower left and right, must be fully drawn, completed if previously cropped, and surrounded by empty space. No part of hair may touch an image boundary. Pull the camera back until it all fits.
Preserve the identical pastel peach-blonde long wavy hair with pink ends, ahoge, two fluffy cat ears, pink flower clip and black X clip. Keep the front-view style and the hollow face/neck opening completely empty. No face, no body, no collar, no bell, no yellow or white debris. A single isolated full hairstyle, beautifully crisp outline and clean genuine transparent background. Do not add any text, frames, diagrams, duplicate view or mannequin.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: isolated collar accessory reference for image-to-3D modeling.
Input image 1 is the master character; the small BLACK NECK CHOKER and its small GOLDEN NECK BELL are the edit target. Do not use the pink bow or the larger tail bell.
Create a close-up of ONLY that neck choker as a complete wearable closed band, preserving its simple narrow black leather-like ribbon, very subtle edge thickness, small gold studs, and one polished spherical gold bell hanging at the front center from a small gold connector. The bell has a fine dark slit like a small cat bell. Retain the understated design and proportions of the master: black band with little gold details, no bow, no spikes, no chain, no added decoration.
Show a SINGLE isolated object from a nearly frontal, slightly elevated view, enough to see the hollow oval loop of the full band and distinguish front and rear band. The loop has a WHITE EMPTY CENTER and readable physical thickness, sized for the character's slender neck. No neck, skin, head, hair, mannequin, torso, clothes or stand anywhere.
Match the clean pastel anime asset illustration and softly shaded material style of the reference, clear black band silhouette and warm gold bell, neutral even studio illumination. Large centered object on square pure white canvas with comfortable margins. No text, labels, arrows, multiple views, collage, floor shadow or watermark.
